description: Reference carry across a named mid-table team set in turn 0.

turns.query: Where did Brighton finish in the 2023-2024 Premier League table?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT tss_rank FROM team_season_standings tss JOIN seasons s ON tss.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2023-2024' AND tss_team = 'Brighton';

turns.query: How many points did they get that season?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT tss_points FROM team_season_standings tss JOIN seasons s ON tss.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2023-2024' AND tss_team = 'Brighton';

turns.query: And how many goals did they score?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT tss_goals_for FROM team_season_standings tss JOIN seasons s ON tss.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2023-2024' AND tss_team = 'Brighton';
